qs: Three hammers are heated to the same temperature. One is made of wood, one of steel, and one of rubber. If the hammer was placed in either water or air of the same temperature, which hammer will cool the fastest?

The focus points of the question are which substance, in which environment, cools the quickest. Metal has a lower heat capacity than wood or rubber meaning it will cool off quicker. While water has a high heat capacity, it is less so than air. Therefore, it is steel in water.
Which parcel would be the most stable?

The question deals with weight distribution. The parcel will pivot about one of the ends of the ropes to which it is attached. It won’t take much disturbance or weight redistribution to make the parcel in B rotate about the point it is attached to the rope. The most stable will be A because the pivot points are right at each edge of the parcel, and hence would require the most force to lift and twist it.
Which of the connected cogs depicted will have the highest Revolutions per Minute (RPM)?
All will have the same RPM
D is the smallest cog. As such, as the chain moves it will be quicker for it make a complete revolution. Therefore, it will have the highest RPM.
Given that the same amount of water is pumped through each pipe; which pipe would allow the water to reach the furthest?

The thinner the pipe, the more quickly the water can be transferred through it. C has a bend which will slow the water down. B has different widths which will also slow the water down. A is thicker than D. As such, D is the thinnest and thus the water will reach the furthest.
Given that each object has the same surface area, which one is the most aerodynamic?
The shape of the object will impact the drag of the aerodynamic air flow. In shape A, the shape allows for minimal drag as the small end of the cone meets the air flow. Therefore, A is correct.
Which way would the helicopter appear to tilt in order to fly forward?

Helicopter flight controls the way it maintains aerodynamic flight. By moving clockwise, in other words dipping forward so the nose goes down, the angle of attack of the main rotor blades creates a different amount of lift. This allows it to fly forward. Only clockwise pushes it forward.
Which balloon is experiencing the least pressure?
They all experience the same amount of pressure

Pressure decreases as altitude increases, hence the balloon hovering around 20 miles up into the atmosphere would be experiencing less atmospheric pressure than the balloon hovering between 10 and 15 miles up into the atmosphere.
In the following cog and belt system, how many cogs will spin anti-clockwise?
None of the cogs will spin anticlockwise
When a cog moves in one direction, the adjacent touching cog will move the opposite. Therefore, given that we have 10 cogs, all of the connected to another, we will thus have 5 anticlockwise cogs.
Which stop sign is likely to have the largest impact on the ground if the whole stop sign fell over?
Sign C is the tallest with the largest size. Therefore, it will have the largest impact when it falls over.
Given that each drone and its attached object is identical, which of the three drones is the most stable?

The question deals with weight distribution impacting its centre of gravity. The only difference from each drone is the length of the cable holding the package. The shorter the cable the stronger the centre of gravity. Therefore, C is the correct answer.
Which sled is most likely to be the fastest down an icy slope, considering the only difference is the width of their runners?

The question deals with aerodynamics. The thinner the longitudinal runners, the less drag the sled will have and thus the fastest it will go. A has the thinnest longitudinal runners and therefore will go the fastest.
Given that each object has the same pacing between and size of the teeth, which wheel will have the highest Revolutions per Minute (RPM)?

The question allows the only factor to be the amount of teeth the wheel has and thus its RPM. The lower the number of teeth, the more RPM the wheel will do. Given that A has the lowest number of teeth, it will have the highest RPM.
Which method of carrying a spade would require the least amount of effort?
All require the same amount of effort

The question deals with weight distribution. With an outstretched arm, the gravitational pull would require more amount to counteract. C has the spade by the side and thus exerting the least amount of effort.
In which order will the scissors require the least force to cut a ware (rank from least force to most force)?
B and C, then A and D
A and B, then C and D
The closer to the edge of the scissors, the greater the force required to cut a ware. Thus, the order should be from the furthest from the edge to the closest. Therefore, A B C D.
How many of the corner wheels will spin anticlockwise if the string were pulled up?
If the string were pulled up, all of the wheels will spin clockwise, except the middle wheel, which is the only one to spin anticlockwise. Therefore, 1.
If each spring was pressed down upon, which one of them would be compressed the furthest?

If the spring were pressed down upon, they would each increase their resulting force to return to decompression. The longer/taller the spring, the greater the necessary compression. Since C is the tallest spring it would be compressed the furthest.
Given that each metal grid has identical mass, when placed on a surface of water, which one would most likely be first to sink?

The grid with the greater surface area will allow it to float easier. Likewise, the smaller surface area will let it sink easier. As such, the first to sink would be A – the grid with the smallest surface area.
Three, non-absorbent, 2 cubic metre objects are half submerged into a pool of water. What will happen to the water level?
The water level would not change
It will lower by 1.5 cubic metres of water
It will rise by 1.5 cubic metres of water
It will lower by 3 cubic metres of water
It will rise by 3 cubic metres of water

Three 2 cubic metres objects, totalling 6 cubic metres are submerged into a pool of water. They are non-absorbent so the water does not occupy the same space. They are only half submerged, so 6 is now halved to 3 cubic metres. Since it is being added to the water and not replacing the space, it will thus rise by 3 cubic metres of water.
Which is the least likely to fall over from a powerful wind?

The question is concerned with aerodynamics. Since the signs are not to scale, it is hard to tell which is the biggest or smallest – which would impact aerodynamic flow. The various holes in the signs would also impact aerodynamic flow, but are again too random in shape and position that it is impossible to tell which is the least likely to fall over from a powerful wind.
Every cog has the same sized teeth and are interlinked. The teeth touch the arrow above them as they rotate. After 120 seconds of rotation, which cog will have hit the arrow the most number of times?
All the same number of times
Every cog has the same sized teeth, are interlinked, and have the same number. Therefore, they will all move as one and thus hit the arrow the same number of times.
